policy: Trusted task queue. Each task reserved exactly once as a GitHub branch to cap unattended API runs. No auto merge.

tasks.title: Document and test v12 Police RP engine adapter contracts
tasks.objective: Inspect police-rp/v1.4/P2P, Integration, and NativeBridge source. Map evidenced contracts and missing callback/authenticated transport dependencies. Add an evidence-backed compatibility report and host tests if warranted. Do not claim runtime device support, preserve APIs.

tasks.title: Strengthen host-only roleplay handshake and replay tests
tasks.objective: Inspect versioned packet parsing, session authority, replay protection, host migration and bounds handling. Add narrowly scoped host tests for a real uncovered edge case, with minimal fix if supported by evidence. Never invent an engine network hook.

tasks.title: Improve Police RP duty and disconnect regression coverage
tasks.objective: Inspect duty state and disconnect/reconnect cleanup. Implement one evidenced regression test or tiny correction within Police RP source and tests. No IPA changes, no hook/offset changes, no signing.
